howItWorks.title: From complex government circulars to clear next steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Every recommendation is driven by deterministic eligibility rules and grounded in verified official government sources.

step1.title: Share basic eligibility details
step1.description: Provide only relevant information such as age, state, district, occupation, education, and household income range. No Aadhaar number is required.

step2.title: Deterministic rule evaluation
step2.description: Our structured eligibility engine evaluates your profile against each scheme's conditions and explains which criteria pass, fail, or need more details.

step3.title: Prepare required documents
step3.description: Organize your required certificates, review extracted document fields, and track your application readiness before visiting the official portal.

step4.title: Apply on the official portal
step4.description: Use your prepared checklist and direct official government links to submit your application with confidence.

readinessSection.title: Being eligible is only step one — being document-ready gets you across the finish line
readinessSection.subtitle: SchemeAlly separates eligibility calculation from document readiness so you always know both whether you qualify and which certificates you still need to prepare.

eligibilityCard.title: Deterministic Eligibility Engine
eligibilityCard.description: Evaluates age, residence, income thresholds, education, and category conditions using versioned logical rules — never guesswork.

outcomes.eligible: Eligible — all configured and required conditions have been evaluated and satisfied.
outcomes.notEligible: Not Eligible — a confirmed mandatory condition fails.
outcomes.insufficient: Insufficient Information — required profile information is missing.
outcomes.verification: Potential Match — basic profile conditions match, but additional scheme-specific conditions require verification.

readinessCard.title: Application Readiness Tracker
readinessCard.description: Tracks required documents separately from optional ones and alerts you to missing, unreviewed, or expired certificates.

rules.rule1: Only mandatory scheme documents affect your readiness percentage
rules.rule2: Documents awaiting your review or past expiry are flagged before you apply
rules.rule3: Direct links to official government portals are always provided

aiAllySection.title: Ask questions in English or Tamil, grounded in official scheme sources
aiAllySection.subtitle: AI Ally helps you understand complex scheme rules, required documents, and application steps in plain language — while citing the official source.

capabilities.explain: Explains scheme benefits and eligibility rules in simple Tamil or English
capabilities.missing: Identifies what profile details or documents are still missing
capabilities.citations: Provides official government source references for every explanation

profilePage.title: Your Eligibility Profile
profilePage.subtitle: Provide only the details relevant to government welfare schemes. Every field helps our deterministic engine calculate accurate eligibility matches.
profilePage.privacyBanner: Privacy guarantee: Do not enter Aadhaar numbers. Sensitive fields like social category or disability status are optional and only used when required by specific schemes.
profilePage.completionGuidance: Date of birth, state, and annual household income are needed for initial eligibility matching. Other profile details can improve the results; sensitive details remain optional.
profilePage.onboardingIncompleteBadge: Add core details to unlock full matching
profilePage.savedSuccess: Your eligibility profile has been saved.

personal.title: 1. Basic Personal Information
personal.reason: Why we ask: Many education, maternity, senior citizen, and women welfare schemes depend on age and gender criteria.

residence.title: 2. Residence & Jurisdiction
residence.reason: Why we ask: Determines whether Tamil Nadu state schemes, district-specific initiatives, and Central Government schemes apply to you.

educationEmployment.title: 3. Education & Occupation
educationEmployment.reason: Why we ask: Scholarships, skill training, artisan support, and employment schemes match against student and employment status.

householdIncome.title: 4. Household & Financial Context
householdIncome.reason: Why we ask: Most government financial assistance and subsidy schemes specify an annual household income ceiling.

additionalEligibility.title: 5. Optional Category, Agriculture & Livelihood Details
additionalEligibility.reason: Why we ask: Optional fields used only for schemes specifically supporting farmers, small business owners, Persons with Disabilities, or specific social categories.

sections.eligibilitySubtitle: Evaluated deterministically by SchemeAlly using versioned rule logic:

legal.trustIntro: SchemeAlly only publishes schemes backed by official Central Government and Tamil Nadu Government sources with explicit verification dates. AI Ally and eligibility rules never replace official government scrutiny.
legal.privacyIntro: We collect only the minimum profile details necessary to evaluate scheme eligibility. We do not require raw Aadhaar numbers, and uploaded documents are stored in private, access-controlled storage.
legal.termsIntro: SchemeAlly is an informational discovery and preparation assistant. Final eligibility, benefit disbursement, and application approval rest solely with the respective government department.

footer.disclaimer: SchemeAlly provides informational guidance based on available scheme information. Final eligibility, benefits and approval are determined by the relevant government authority. Always verify the latest requirements on the official government source before applying.
footer.copyright: SchemeAlly — Built for Indian citizens with English & Tamil support.
